scope: Original module and static living-space visual review
observations: All twelve originals were visually reviewed together at consistent scale.
Single and double beds, wide seat surfaces and tabletop food displays retain the existing warm Cropout palette.
The hollow empty basket and the separately filled berry basket are visually distinct.
The 4x4m cabin keeps a central circulation gap; reference shell rotation and its .16m structural-to-finished-floor datum were corrected.
The communal corner has ten seat contact markers. Its woodpile was moved outside the central route after static access-grid checking found a blockage.
Standing rings and height rulers are preview annotations only; overlapping approach pairs require runtime reservations.
